definition.aggregation: runs within subject, then subjects equally; edge ratio quantiles within run before averaging
definition.training_summary: descriptive subject means without inferential confidence intervals
definition.inference: val/full AE-minus-PCA dynamic NMSE is primary; other contrasts exploratory
definition.pca_training: all train LR windows, raw Fisher-z, no per-edge standardization
definition.limitation: fixed AE encode/decode; cannot separate encoder/decoder errors or infer future predictability
